Job Description 





































 What is the Opportunity? 
 We're building the agentic platform that will let every development team at RBC execute AI driven SDLC — our spec-driven, agent-assisted software delivery methodology — at scale. This is a hands-on platform engineering role inside DevOps: you won't be running one team's pipeline, you'll be building the harness, skills, and agents that every team's development workflow runs on.
 If you're the kind of engineer who has already wired tools like Claude Code into your own workflow with custom skills and MCP servers to make yourself dramatically more productive, and you want to turn that instinct into a platform used across an entire bank, this is that role.

 What will you do? 
 Design and build agents across the full software delivery lifecycle: specification creation, technical spec generation, build-and-test agents, and operational agents that automate deployment, release, PIV (post-implementation verification), and post-deployment tasks
 Build these agents on coding harnesses via custom skills and tools (including MCP servers), on managed agent platforms such as Devin, and as native agents using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph — choosing the right substrate for each use case
 Implement and extend spec-driven development workflows (e.g., specify → clarify → plan → tasks → analyze → implement, in the style of GitHub spec-kit / SpecKit) as the backbone of the platform's golden path
 Build the technical plumbing that enforces AI-DLC's gates (e.g., Spec Ready, PR Ready) as machine-checked controls rather than advisory guidance
 Continuously push what frontier models and coding harnesses like Claude Code can automate — both at a personal productivity level and as reusable capability that scales across other development teams
 Partner with DevOps, security, and platform teams to get new agents and skills safely into production and into the shared skill/tool catalog
 Evaluate emerging agentic AI platforms, frameworks, and design patterns, and make build-vs-adopt recommendations for the platform roadmap
 Regularly demonstrate what you've built to other development teams — explaining not just what an agent does, but how it works — to build trust and drive adoption of the platform
 Act as a hands-on technical resource and champion for teams adopting AI-DLC, helping them get unblocked on the platform
 
 What do you need to succeed? 

 Must-have: 
 Strong software development background (Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript) with the ability to build and operate production-grade services, not just prototypes
 Hands-on experience building agent-based solutions — e.g., with LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable agent frameworks – even within coding harnesses like Claude Code.
 Practical experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and building custom skills/tools for coding harnesses such as Claude Code
 Demonstrated personal fluency with frontier coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) for real engineering work, including multi-agent workflows
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes) — you understand what deployment, release, and post-deployment automation actually needs to do
 Familiarity with wider software development lifecycle, including product discovery, stakeholder requirements gathering, design and architecture
 Strong communicator, comfortable presenting and demoing technical work to other development teams and translating platform capabilities into terms application teams can act on
 Strong software architecture and system design skills; comfortable making platform-level tradeoffs that will be consumed by many other teams
 
 Nice-to-have: 
 Experience with spec-driven development paradigms, particularly GitHub spec-kit / SpecKit — a significant advantage for this role
 Experience with autonomous coding agent platforms such as Devin, Claude Code or similar products
 Familiarity with AI-DLC or comparable structured, gate-based AI-assisted delivery methodologies
 Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, with awareness of the security/compliance constraints that shape enterprise agent design
 Comfortable defining lightweight usage/adoption signals to help inform the platform roadmap (this is a platform engineering role, not a data/analytics role)
 
 What's in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
 The ability to shape a platform used by development teams across the entire bank, not just a single team or line of business
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and growth opportunities
 Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team at the leading edge of agentic AI adoption in a regulated enterprise
 A world-class training program in financial services and technology
 Flexible work/life balance options
 
 
 Job Skills 
DevOps, Docker (Software), GitHub, GitHub Actions, Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Programming Languages, Red Hat Ansible, Software Change Request Management, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Engineering, Software Integration Engineering, Software Product Design, Software Product Technical Knowledge, Software Release Management, System Testing Tools
